{
  "name": "context-rings",
  "displayName": "Context Rings",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "A ring per active session above the prompt, filled by how much of its context window is used; newest activity first, hover for the name",
  "author": {
    "name": "Sravan",
    "url": "https://github.com/nvsravank"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/nvsravank/context-rings",
  "repository": "https://github.com/nvsravank/context-rings",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "context",
    "context-window",
    "sessions",
    "subagents",
    "compaction",
    "status"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "contextWindow": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Session context window",
      "description": "The window each session's ring fills against.",
      "options": [
        "100K",
        "200K",
        "300K",
        "400K",
        "500K",
        "600K",
        "700K",
        "800K",
        "900K",
        "1M"
      ],
      "default": "1M"
    },
    "mainYellow": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Session ring turns yellow at",
      "description": "Percent of the session context window.",
      "options": [
        "30%",
        "40%",
        "50%",
        "60%",
        "70%",
        "75%",
        "80%",
        "90%"
      ],
      "default": "50%"
    },
    "mainRed": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Session ring turns red at",
      "description": "Percent of the session context window.",
      "options": [
        "50%",
        "60%",
        "70%",
        "75%",
        "80%",
        "85%",
        "90%",
        "95%"
      ],
      "default": "80%"
    },
    "subagentLimit": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subagent limit",
      "description": "The limit a subagent's dot is measured against.",
      "options": [
        "100K",
        "200K",
        "300K",
        "400K",
        "500K",
        "600K",
        "700K",
        "800K",
        "900K",
        "1M"
      ],
      "default": "200K"
    },
    "subagentYellow": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subagent dot appears (yellow) at",
      "description": "Percent of the subagent limit. Below this a subagent is not shown.",
      "options": [
        "30%",
        "40%",
        "50%",
        "60%",
        "70%",
        "75%",
        "80%",
        "90%"
      ],
      "default": "75%"
    },
    "subagentRed": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subagent dot turns red (and toasts) at",
      "description": "Percent of the subagent limit. A toast warns once per subagent when it gets here.",
      "options": [
        "50%",
        "60%",
        "70%",
        "75%",
        "80%",
        "85%",
        "90%",
        "95%"
      ],
      "default": "90%"
    }
  }
}
